Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 100. Category: feat. Non-race Specific D&DBZ Feats.

This feat may be taken once per ki rank
Must have the “Mysticism” class feature
Your intense study of the arane arts has awakened
another way to use your magic. You gain 1 branch of
magic as if you gained the “Mysticism” Feature.\
